d:
The Heat defeated the Cavaliers, 133-121 tonight in Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed a team-high 37 points to go with 9 rebounds and 2 assists, with Bam Adebayo of the Heat adding an additional 37 points (13-19 FG, 2-3 3P) in the game. Donovan Mitchell finished with a team-high 25 points along with 7 assists for the Cavaliers in the losing effort. The Heat improve their record to 6-6 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 6-7 for the season.
